finalists.label: Kummell disease
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as L5 burst fracture with canal compromise and an intravertebral vacuum cleft at L5, and a T2-weighted “double line sign” at L5.

finalists.label: Spinal cord injury
finalists.why: It explains the progressive bilateral leg weakness and specific muscle weaknesses without significant trauma history.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a T2-weighted “double line sign” at L5 and an intravertebral vacuum cleft, which are characteristic of Kummell disease, decided the final comparison.
